summary: CoreWeave filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement covering up to 35,000,000 shares of Class A common stock under a September 17, 2026 Equity Distribution Agreement — an at-the-market (ATM) program, the US equivalent of a shelf takedown. Shares sell at prevailing market prices through eleven sales agents including Deutsche Bank, Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan, Jefferies, Morgan Stanley, MUFG, Citigroup, Credit Agricole, SG, TD and Wells Fargo, with commissions up to 2.0%. Collared forward sale agreements with Deutsche Bank AG London, Goldman Sachs Bank USA, Morgan Stanley and Citibank are permitted; no price, premium or close date stated. Issuer receives no initial proceeds from forward sales. Watch dilution pace, forward unwind mechanics and share overhang.
